about: B-ASKJB-44 round 11: the critic's fresh sets, copied read-only as a corpus for the monotonicity property test (handoffFloor.monotonic.test.ts). critic-r9 = scratchpad critic-askjb/r9/fresh2.json, critic-r10 = r10/fresh3.json (`critic` is the critic's required verdict under the round-10 contract, kept for reference only); critic-r11 = r11/fresh11.json (62 rows; `must` is text the critic requires in the output); floor-probe* = the critic's floor-probe.mts .. floor-probe4.mts cases (parent '' = the probe gave none; floor-probe4's parent is the probe's own).
